weather.condition: 天氣清涼，多雲有雨。稍後雨勢逐漸減弱。
weather.outlook: 未來一兩日早上仍然清涼，天色逐漸好轉。接近週末日間乾燥。

items.title: Kremlin says continuing peace talks with Ukraine is in Russia's own interests
items.title_zh: 克里姆林宮稱繼續與烏克蘭進行和平談判符合俄羅斯自身利益
items.desc: The Kremlin stated on Monday that it was in Russia's own interests to continue peace talks with Ukraine and that Moscow's preference was still to reach a diplomatic settlement to end the fighting. A new round of U.S.-brokered peace talks between Ukraine and Russia, scheduled for this week, has not been canceled following the weekend strikes on Iran.
items.desc_zh: 克里姆林宮週一表示，繼續與烏克蘭進行和平談判符合俄羅斯自身利益，莫斯科仍希望通過外交解決方案結束戰鬥。原定於本週舉行的美國斡旋的烏克蘭與俄羅斯新一輪和平談判在週末伊朗遭襲後並未取消。

items.title: Trump's tariff wars reshaped US-China trade - at what cost to American firms?
items.title_zh: 特朗普的關稅戰重塑了中美貿易——美國企業付出了什麼代價？
items.desc: Studies by the National Bureau of Economic Research and the Kiel Institute estimated that US consumers and businesses pay a total of 94% and 96% of the tariffs, respectively. Ford estimated its 2025 net loss from trade policy at $2 billion, while GM warned that 2026 costs could swell to $4 billion due to the full-year implementation of the global surcharges.
items.desc_zh: 美國國家經濟研究局和基爾研究所的研究估計，美國消費者和企業分別承擔了94%和96%的關稅成本。福特估計其2025年因貿易政策造成的淨虧損達20億美元，而通用汽車警告稱，由於全球附加稅的全年實施，2026年的成本可能膨脹至40億美元。

items.title: How Trump's tariffs have reshaped the global economy, in 11 charts
items.title_zh: 特朗普關稅如何重塑全球經濟（11張圖表）
items.desc: The United States posted its largest goods trade deficit on record in 2025. China essentially stopped buying US exports in April 2025 after President Donald Trump started his second term by launching a new trade war with steep new tariffs on China. Jobs growth declined significantly in 2025.
items.desc_zh: 美國在2025年創下了有史以來最大的商品貿易逆差。唐納德·特朗普總統開始第二任期後對中國發動新一輪貿易戰並徵收高額新關稅，中國實質上從2025年4月起停止購買美國出口商品。2025年就業增長大幅下降。

items.title: Russia's attacks on energy system force ArcelorMittal to close Ukrainian division
items.title_zh: 俄羅斯對能源系統的襲擊迫使安賽樂米塔爾關閉烏克蘭分部
items.desc: Ukraine's major steelmaker ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih is closing another of its divisions in Ukraine due to a deepening energy crisis caused by Russia's ongoing attacks on the Ukrainian energy system, the company said on Friday.
items.desc_zh: 烏克蘭主要鋼鐵製造商安賽樂米塔爾克里維里赫週五表示，由於俄羅斯持續襲擊烏克蘭能源系統導致能源危機加深，該公司正在關閉其在烏克蘭的另一個分部。

items.title: China, South Korea, and Japan agreed to strengthen free trade after Trump tariffs
items.title_zh: 中日韓同意在特朗普關稅後加強自由貿易
items.desc: On March 30, China, South Korea, and Japan agreed to strengthen free trade cooperation in response to the Trump administration's tariff policies, marking a significant shift in regional economic cooperation.
items.desc_zh: 3月30日，中國、韓國和日本同意加強自由貿易合作以應對特朗普政府的關稅政策，這標誌著區域經濟合作的重要轉變。

items.title: China's Two Sessions to project stability with expected GDP trim
items.title_zh: 中國兩會預計下調GDP目標以展現穩定
items.desc: With two-thirds of Chinese provinces already trimming their own targets, many economists expect Premier Li Qiang to lower the national GDP target to a range of 4.5 per cent to 5 per cent when the NPC opens. The upcoming 'two sessions' set stage for strong start to China's new five-year plan.
items.desc_zh: 隨著中國三分之二的省份已經下調了自己的目標，許多經濟學家預計李克強總理將在全國人大開幕時將國內生產總值目標下調至4.5%至5%的範圍。即將召開的「兩會」為中國新的五年計劃強勢開局奠定基礎。

items.title: Xinhua Commentary: Upcoming 'two sessions' set stage for strong start
items.title_zh: 新華社評論：即將召開的「兩會」為強勢開局奠定基礎
items.desc: As the annual national 'two sessions' approach, China is expected to send strong and fresh signals on pushing high-quality development, leveraging greater policy and reform support to ensure steady economic growth and social progress.
items.desc_zh: 隨著全國年度「兩會」臨近，中國預計將就推動高質量發展發出強烈而清新的信號，利用更大的政策和改革支持來確保經濟穩定增長和社會進步。

items.title: China's leaders gather for key strategy session as challenges grow
items.title_zh: 隨著挑戰加劇，中國領導人召開關鍵戰略會議
items.desc: China's economy expanded by five percent in 2025, in line with Beijing's target. The Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) opens on March 4, generally overshadowed by the next day's opening of the National People's Congress, where Premier Li Qiang will outline key growth targets.
items.desc_zh: 中國經濟在2025年增長了5%，符合北京的目標。中國人民政治協商會議於3月4日開幕，通常被第二天全國人民代表大會的開幕所掩蓋，屆時李克強總理將概述關鍵增長目標。

items.title: DeepSeek V4 tests China's AI ambitions against US rivals
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4測試中國AI雄心與美國競爭對手的較量
items.desc: China's DeepSeek is reportedly preparing to release its latest AI model. DeepSeek first captured serious attention in late January 2025 when it released its R1 reasoning model, which demonstrated performance comparable to OpenAI's most advanced offerings at a fraction of the cost.
items.desc_zh: 據報導，中國的DeepSeek正在準備發布其最新的AI模型。DeepSeek在2025年1月下旬發布其R1推理模型時首次引起嚴重關注，該模型以極低的成本展示了與OpenAI最先進產品相當的性能。

items.title: China's AI Race Accelerates, MiniMax M2.5 Attracts Global Attention
items.title_zh: 中國AI競賽加速，MiniMax M2.5吸引全球關注
items.desc: China's technology firms are rapidly strengthening their position in the global artificial intelligence market. Even as discussions around the DeepSeek model continue, several Chinese companies have launched new generative AI models in recent weeks. Experts believe that low-cost and high-performance models are reshaping the industry.
items.desc_zh: 中國科技公司正在迅速加強其在全球人工智能市場的地位。即使在關於DeepSeek模型的討論繼續進行之際，幾家中國公司在最近幾週推出了新的生成式AI模型。專家認為，低成本高性能模型正在重塑行業。

items.title: HK budget pivots to tech and talent amidst commercial property stagnation
items.title_zh: 香港預算案在商業地產停滯之際轉向科技和人才
items.desc: Hong Kong's budget focuses on technology development and talent attraction as commercial property market faces stagnation. The government is waiving the buy-side stamp duty on stock trading to boost trading volume and reviewing tax exemptions for intellectual property-related expenditures.
items.desc_zh: 隨著商業地產市場面臨停滯，香港預算案將重點放在科技發展和吸引人才上。政府將豁免股票買方印花稅以提振交易量，並審查與知識產權相關支出的稅收豁免。

items.title: Cathay Pacific extends flight suspensions to Dubai, Riyadh until March 14
items.title_zh: 國泰航空延長往返迪拜、利雅得航班停飛至3月14日
items.desc: Hong Kong's flag carrier, Cathay Pacific Airways, has announced it will extend flight suspensions to Dubai and the Saudi capital Riyadh until next Saturday, as ongoing airspace closures continue to disrupt tours in the Persian Gulf.
items.desc_zh: 香港國泰航空宣布將延長往返迪拜和沙特首都利雅得的航班停飛至下週六，因持續的領空關閉繼續擾亂波斯灣地區的旅遊。

items.title: Fines and penalties pump HK$2.1 billion into government coffers
items.title_zh: 罰款和罰金為政府庫房帶來21億港元
items.desc: Fines worth HK$2.1 billion (US$268.39 million) flowed into Hong Kong's coffers in 2025-26, nearly 26 per cent more than initially forecast, following an increase in cigarette penalties and a surge in forfeitures. According to budget estimates, the HK$2.1 billion income amounted to 0.3 per cent of the government's total revenue.
items.desc_zh: 2025-26年度，價值21億港元（2.6839億美元）的罰款流入香港庫房，比最初預測高出近26%，這是由於香煙罰款增加和沒收款項激增。根據預算估算，21億港元的收入佔政府總收入的0.3%。

items.title: 'Two sessions' to focus on Hong Kong's financial role, Northern Metropolis
items.title_zh: 「兩會」將聚焦香港金融角色及北部都會區
items.desc: Xia Baolong, director of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office (HKMAO), is scheduled to meet local delegates in a closed-door session on Tuesday. The meetings will focus on Hong Kong's role as an international financial center and the development of the Northern Metropolis.
items.desc_zh: 國務院港澳辦主任夏寶龍定於週二與香港代表閉門會面。會議將聚焦香港作為國際金融中心的角色以及北部都會區的發展。

items.title: Hong Kong Art Week unveils exciting initiatives
items.title_zh: 香港藝術週推出精彩活動
items.desc: Hong Kong's 'art week' in March unveils a series of exciting initiatives, from edible art fairs and open-air exhibitions to tours. Six new fairs, galleries and pop-ups are making Hong Kong art week bigger and bolder this year.
items.desc_zh: 香港三月「藝術週」推出一系列精彩活動，從可食用藝術博覽會、露天展覽到導賞團。六個新展會、畫廊和快閃店讓今年的香港藝術週規模更大、更大膽。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results on March 17, 2026
items.title_zh: 萬國數據將於2026年3月17日公佈第四季度及2025年全年財報
items.desc: GDS Holdings Limited announced that it will report its fourth quarter and full year 2025 unaudited financial results after the close of the Hong Kong market and before the open of the U.S. market on March 17, 2026.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據控股有限公司宣布將於2026年3月17日香港市場收盤後、美國市場開盤前公佈其第四季度及2025年全年未經審核財務業績。

items.title: GDS Announces Private Placement of US$300 Million Convertible Preferred Shares
items.title_zh: 萬國數據宣布3億美元可轉換優先股私募配售
items.desc: On January 30, 2026, GDS Announced Private Placement of US$300 Million convertible preferred shares to a Chinese Institutional Investor. The company also holds a minority equity interest in DayOne Data Centers Limited, a Singapore-headquartered hyperscale data center platform.
items.desc_zh: 2026年1月30日，萬國數據宣布向一家中國機構投資者私募配售3億美元可轉換優先股。該公司還持有DayOne Data Centers Limited的少數股權，這是一家總部位於新加坡的超大型數據中心平台。

items.title: GDS Announces Adjournments of Extraordinary General Meeting to March 10, 2026
items.title_zh: 萬國數據宣布股東特別大會延期至2026年3月10日
items.desc: GDS Announces Adjournments of Extraordinary General Meeting and Additional Shareholders Meetings to be Reconvened on March 10, 2026. The company continues to work on strategic initiatives including its REIT listing plans.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據宣布股東特別大會及額外股東大會延期至2026年3月10日重新召開。公司繼續推進戰略舉措，包括其REIT上市計劃。

items.title: GDS Q4 and 2025 results announcement scheduled
items.title_zh: 萬國數據第四季度及2025年業績公佈時間確定
items.desc: GDS will release Q4 and full year 2025 unaudited results on March 17, 2026. The company is a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China and Southeast Asia, serving hyperscale cloud service providers and large internet companies.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據將於2026年3月17日公佈第四季度及2025年全年未經審核業績。該公司是中國和東南亞領先的高性能數據中心開發和運營商，為超大規模雲服務提供商和大型互聯網公司提供服務。

items.title: GDS Holdings Stock Analysis and Price Target
items.title_zh: 萬國數據股票分析及目標價
items.desc: Should You Buy or Sell GDS Stock? Get The Latest GDS Stock Analysis, Price Target, Earnings Estimates, Headlines, and Short Interest. The company continues to expand its data center footprint across Asia Pacific.
items.desc_zh: 應該買入還是賣出萬國數據股票？獲取最新的萬國數據股票分析、目標價、盈利預測、頭條新聞和做空興趣。該公司繼續擴大其在亞太地區的數據中心佈局。

items.title: Researchers Find 40,000+ Exposed OpenClaw Instances
items.title_zh: 研究人員發現超過40,000個暴露的OpenClaw實例
items.desc: Infosecurity Magazine reports that widespread misconfiguration of popular AI assistant OpenClaw means many instances are exposed to the public-facing internet, SecurityScorecard has warned. Cisco's AI security research team tested a third-party OpenClaw skill and found it performed data exfiltration and prompt injection without user awareness.
items.desc_zh: 《信息安全雜誌》報導，SecurityScorecard警告稱，受歡迎的AI助手OpenClaw的廣泛配置錯誤意味著許多實例暴露在公共互聯網上。思科AI安全研究團隊測試了一個第三方OpenClaw技能，發現它在用戶不知情的情況下執行數據外洩和提示注入。

items.title: Critical OpenClaw Vulnerability Exposes AI Agent Risks
items.title_zh: 關鍵OpenClaw漏洞暴露AI代理風險
items.desc: The now-patched flaw is the latest in a growing string of security issues with the viral AI tool, which has seen rapid adoption among developers. Malicious websites could open a WebSocket connection to localhost on the OpenClaw gateway port, brute force passwords, and take control of the agent.
items.desc_zh: 這個現已修補的漏洞是這款病毒式AI工具一系列安全問題中的最新一個，該工具已在開發者中迅速普及。惡意網站可以打開與OpenClaw網關端口上本地主機的WebSocket連接，暴力破解密碼並控制代理。

items.title: OpenClaw Vulnerability Allowed Websites to Hijack AI Agents
items.title_zh: OpenClaw漏洞允許網站劫持AI代理
items.desc: SecurityWeek reports that malicious websites could open a WebSocket connection to localhost on the OpenClaw gateway port, brute force passwords, and take control of the agent. Researchers revealed six new OpenClaw vulnerabilities in total.
items.desc_zh: 《安全週刊》報導，惡意網站可以打開與OpenClaw網關端口上本地主機的WebSocket連接，暴力破解密碼並控制代理。研究人員總共發現了六個新的OpenClaw漏洞。

items.title: Alibaba Qwen3-Max launched as Chinese AI race accelerates
items.title_zh: 隨著中國AI競賽加速，阿里巴巴推出Qwen3-Max
items.desc: On September 5, 2025, Alibaba launched Qwen3-Max. The Qwen3 model family includes both dense and sparse models trained on 36 trillion tokens in 119 languages and dialects. Chinese labs like DeepSeek, Alibaba, and ByteDance have shipped models that compete on coding and reasoning.
items.desc_zh: 2025年9月5日，阿里巴巴推出Qwen3-Max。Qwen3模型系列包括密集和稀疏模型，在119種語言和方言上訓練了36萬億個標記。DeepSeek、阿里巴巴和字節跳動等中國實驗室已經推出了在編碼和推理方面具有競爭力的模型。

items.title: Apple announces $599 iPhone 17e with AI features
items.title_zh: 蘋果宣布推出599美元的iPhone 17e，具備AI功能
items.desc: Apple announced a $599 entry-level smartphone, the iPhone 17e, as well as two new iPad Airs. The company is expanding its AI features across its product lineup while keeping the Neural Engine requirements for on-device processing.
items.desc_zh: 蘋果宣布推出售價599美元的入門級智能手機iPhone 17e，以及兩款新iPad Air。該公司正在其產品線中擴展AI功能，同時保持設備端處理的神經引擎要求。

items.title: Nvidia unveils Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin chips at GTC 2025
items.title_zh: 英偉達在GTC 2025發佈Blackwell Ultra和Vera Rubin芯片
items.desc: At GTC 2025, Nvidia unveiled its next-generation AI hardware, the Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin chips, signaling a leap toward more powerful AI processing. NVIDIA and Coherent announced a multiyear strategic partnership on March 2, 2026 to accelerate optics for next-generation AI data centers.
items.desc_zh: 在GTC 2025上，英偉達發佈了其下一代AI硬件Blackwell Ultra和Vera Rubin芯片，標誌著向更強大的AI處理能力邁進。英偉達和Coherent於2026年3月2日宣布建立多年戰略合作夥伴關係，以加速下一代AI數據中心的光學技術。

items.title: Researchers Reveal Six New OpenClaw Vulnerabilities
items.title_zh: 研究人員揭示六個新的OpenClaw漏洞
items.desc: Endor Labs revealed last week that it had discovered seven vulnerabilities in total in OpenClaw. AI-specific patterns require specialized analysis. Traditional static application security testing (SAST) tools designed for regular web apps aren't able to identify issues in LLM-to-tool flows.
items.desc_zh: Endor Labs上週透露，它在OpenClaw中總共發現了七個漏洞。AI特定模式需要專門分析。為常規網絡應用設計的傳統靜態應用安全測試（SAST）工具無法識別LLM到工具流程中的問題。
